format: Certificate (Q, b) for the J_4-free problem, objective f = cosig3: f(H) = F(H)/210, F(H) = 210 - sum over the 35 4-subsets Q of [7] of C(e_H(Q), 2) (sigma_n = 1 - f in BCL's x != y form).  Graphs: 3-graphs on [7] as 35-bit masks, bit i = the i-th 3-subset in colex order ({a<b<c} -> a + C(b,2) + C(c,3)).  For every key k = (block (s, m), type): Q_k = A_k^T A_k / M^2 with A_k = cert.npz['A<k>'] (integer rows, M = 2^M_bits), rows/columns indexed by keys[k]['flags'] in the listed order.  A flag of key k is a 3-graph on [m] (mask in colex order on [m]) whose restriction to [s] is the type keys[k]['sigma'] (canonical labelled mask on [s]); it is listed in canonical form = the minimum mask over all permutations of [m] fixing 0..s-1 pointwise.  M_k(H)[F1, F2] = (number of configurations (theta, U1, U2) with theta an injective map [s] -> [7] such that H[theta] relabelled theta_i -> i equals sigma_k exactly, U1, U2 disjoint (m - s)-subsets of [7] - theta(ordered pair), flag of theta + U1 = F1 and of theta + U2 = F2) / (number of configurations of block (s, m)).  slack(H) = f(H) - sum_k <Q_k, M_k(H)>.  The certificate states slack(H) >= bound for every J_4-free H on [7] (both exhaustive exact scans), hence by the plain flag-algebra argument (Q_k PSD) sigma(J_4) <= 1 - bound.  Engine evaluation: Z(H) = sum_terms wint * Qsum, Qsum_k = sum over Aut(sigma_k) of the relabelled Gram A_k^T A_k, <Q, M(H)> = Z(H) / (5040 M^2); groups = [F, max Z over the graphs with this F, an argmax graph, count].
